shelters.name: San Francisco SPCA
shelters.description: Independent nonprofit since 1868, fourth oldest humane society in the U.S. and founders of the No-Kill movement. Offers world-class veterinary care and SF's largest adoption center.

shelters.name: San Diego Humane Society
shelters.description: Works to create a more humane world by inspiring compassion, providing hope, and advancing the welfare of animals and people. Operates multiple campuses across San Diego County.

shelters.name: spcaLA
shelters.description: Independent nonprofit serving Southern California since 1877. Dedicated to prevention of cruelty to animals through education, law enforcement, intervention, and advocacy.

shelters.name: Los Angeles County Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: One of the largest animal care and control agencies in the nation, operating seven animal care centers and providing services to over three million residents.

shelters.name: Los Angeles Animal Services
shelters.description: City of Los Angeles department promoting and protecting the health, safety and welfare of animals and people through multiple shelter locations.

shelters.name: Pasadena Humane
shelters.description: Donor-supported nonprofit providing compassionate care for animals since 1903 in the Greater Los Angeles Area.

shelters.name: Humane Society Silicon Valley
shelters.description: Operating continuously since 1929, world's first model shelter to meet 543 Guidelines for Standards of Care. First animal community center to receive Gold LEED certification.

shelters.name: East Bay SPCA
shelters.description: One of the oldest shelters in the country, committed to the welfare of cats and dogs. Independent local nonprofit not affiliated with any national organization.

shelters.name: Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA
shelters.description: Private, independent, open-door animal shelter providing pet adoptions, animal rescue & control, wildlife services, and behavior classes. All donations stay local.

shelters.name: Sacramento SPCA
shelters.description: The only full-service 100% nonprofit animal shelter in the Sacramento region, independent and relying on community donations.

shelters.name: Berkeley Humane
shelters.description: Serves the people and animals of the community by providing life-saving programs for cats and dogs.

shelters.name: SPCA Monterey County
shelters.description: Independent local SPCA since 1905. Open admission shelter for all animals in need including dogs, cats, horses, rabbits, wildlife, and more.

shelters.name: Helen Woodward Animal Center
shelters.description: Educates on animal care, offers pet adoption programs, and runs an equine therapy program. One of the largest animal welfare organizations in San Diego County.

shelters.name: OC Animal Care
shelters.description: Provides animal control services to thirteen contract cities and unincorporated areas of Orange County, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

shelters.name: Irvine Animal Care Center
shelters.description: Provides sheltering, care, and enrichment for homeless, neglected, abused, or unwanted animals. Services include licensing, pet adoptions, and events.

shelters.name: Central California SPCA
shelters.description: Nonprofit humane society saving animals in the Central Valley since 1895 with modern facilities and caring staff.

shelters.name: Fresno Humane Animal Services
shelters.description: Committed to providing progressive animal services with the goal of improving quality of life for both animals and humans in Fresno County.

shelters.name: Valley Animal Center
shelters.description: Dedicated to controlling the pet population through education and spaying/neutering, not euthanasia.

shelters.name: Inland Valley Humane Society & SPCA
shelters.description: Provides animal care and control services to Chino Hills, Claremont, Covina, Diamond Bar, Glendora, La Verne, Pomona, and San Dimas.

shelters.name: San Bernardino Animal Services
shelters.description: Municipal shelter serving San Bernardino, Colton, Grand Terrace, Fontana, Loma Linda, and Rialto with animal control and adoption services.

shelters.name: Muttville Senior Dog Rescue
shelters.description: Rescues and finds homes for neglected senior dogs, providing companionship to seniors in San Francisco.

shelters.name: Best Friends Animal Society - Los Angeles
shelters.description: National organization's LA initiative developing a model for saving lives in high-density urban environments struggling with animal homelessness.

shelters.name: Rancho Coastal Humane Society
shelters.description: Private, nonprofit animal welfare organization serving San Diego County with shelter and adoption services.

shelters.name: Santa Cruz County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: County shelter providing animal control and adoption services for Santa Cruz County residents.

shelters.name: Animal Rescue of Fresno
shelters.description: Saving homeless dogs since 1998 in the Fresno area through rescue, foster, and adoption programs.

shelters.name: Napa Humane
shelters.description: Nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting the welfare of companion animals in Napa County.

shelters.name: Sonoma Humane Society
shelters.description: Serving Sonoma County with comprehensive animal welfare services including adoption, rescue, and community programs.

shelters.name: Sacramento County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: County-operated shelter providing animal care and control services for Sacramento County.

shelters.name: San Jose Animal Care Center
shelters.description: City of San Jose municipal shelter providing animal care services, adoptions, and community programs.

shelters.name: Riverside County Animal Services
shelters.description: Provides animal control and shelter services throughout Riverside County with multiple locations.

notes: Comprehensive collection of California animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. California has the largest shelter system in the US. Coverage spans major metros including Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, Sacramento, Oakland, San Jose, Fresno, and Orange County. SF SPCA (founded 1868) is the fourth oldest humane society in the US and founders of the No-Kill movement.
